title: Process descendant tracking
responsibility: Tracks a command’s process identities through parent and group observations and signals only still-matching tracked processes.

inputs.name: processDescendants.root
inputs.description: Root command pid to begin tracking while that command has not yet been reaped.

inputs.name: processDescendants.read
inputs.description: Optional process-table reader, defaulting to the system ps reader; null or rejection means unreadable.

inputs.name: signalProcesses.known
inputs.description: Tracked pids and start times eligible for a fresh identity check before signalling.

inputs.name: signalProcesses.signal
inputs.description: SIGTERM or SIGKILL to send to still-matching identities.

outputs.name: processTable
outputs.description: System process rows containing pid, parent, group and start time, or null if the bounded ps read fails or omits this process.

outputs.name: processDescendants
outputs.description: Tracker with look, survivors, alive and closed methods. It remembers parent provenance and start times, marks unsupported group-only identities unproven, and stops treating a reused root pid as the original command.

outputs.name: signalProcesses
outputs.description: Resolves after attempting signals only for supplied identities still present in a fresh process table. Empty/unreadable tables send no signals; kill errors are ignored.
